items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And I worked with Charlie Johnson there for about a year.

ctx.x: When I got back to Philly, he called me. He say, 'Where you at?' I say, 'I'm home.' 'Will you come on back, we're waiting for you?' So the next day I came back, and I worked over at 5th Avenue, that club that Ed Small had over there for about a couple of months.
It was like a private club. Then he moved me over to Small's Paradise. And I worked with Charlie Johnson there for about a year.
Then that's where I met Benny Waters. And then Benny Carter was in the band, and he was just getting started -- him and Benny Waters. He had a great band.
